text:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Increased 5xx errors for prod-canary on service `user-profile` after release 2026-03-15T09:50Z. Source: healthcheck failures + app logs. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/xyz/user-profile-deploys

sre-bot: PagerDuty incident created PD-67900. Primary: @emma

emma: acknowledging. moving to incident mode here. grabbing deploy and DB logs.

ton y_release: reverting canary? Rollout shows failures after migration step `20260315_rename_owner` ran.

rachel_db: joining. Quick summary from DB: migration attempted to rename column `user_id` -> `owner_id` on `profiles` but ran into FK constraint because some services still write `user_id`. Migration failed mid-run and left a partial rename on some partitions.

nina: app logs show KeyError: 'owner_id' from profile-service v2; stable v1 still uses user_id. Canary pods running v2 hit missing column and returned 500s.

emma: immediate actions: 1) pause canary rollout (should auto-pause) 2) toggle release kill-switch to serve stable binary 3) engage DB team for rollback/fix 4) notify affected customers

tony_release: pausing rollout now -> console shows canary paused at 8%. Toggling flag `release_20260315_profile_api` OFF -> `/admin/flags set release_20260315_profile_api false`

ops-bot: :gear: Flag change recorded by @tony_release at 09:53Z. Traffic for canary routed to stable instances.

emma: confirm traffic fallback?

nina: yes, traffic is hitting stable service instances. 5xxs dropped from ~70/s to baseline ~3/s within 60s.

rachel_db: digging into DB state. `ALTER TABLE profiles RENAME COLUMN user_id TO owner_id;` executed but an earlier async job created a materialized view referencing user_id which now errors. The migration tool attempted to run a schema patch on partitioned tables and failed halfway. We also see an open txn holding a DDL lock from pid 33421 on db-writer-01.

emma: should we kill pid 33421? Risk/benefit?

rachel_db: terminate is safest to release locks; the migration transaction is idle-in-transaction. We'll terminate, then apply a compatibility shim: create `owner_id` as a computed column from `user_id` or a view to satisfy v2 until we can backfill. Proposed corrective SQL for canary DB first:
```sql
BEGIN;
-- if owner_id missing, add it as nullable
ALTER TABLE profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS owner_id bigint;
-- copy data from user_id where owner_id is null
UPDATE profiles SET owner_id = user_id WHERE owner_id IS NULL;
-- ensure constraints ok, then set NOT NULL if safe
COMMIT;
```

emma: that approach avoids renaming in place and keeps stable writes working. Good. Run kill+patch on canary DB only.

rachel_db: pg_terminate_backend(33421) -> success. Session rolled back.

rachel_db: applying patch on canary DB now. Update stats: scanned 1.6M rows, updated 1.6M rows, duration ~52s. No locks remain.

nina: redeploying canary app pods with v2? They should pick up owner_id now.

ton y_release: restarting canary service pods to clear caches and env.

nina: healthchecks returning green. /profile endpoints respond 200. No 500s in the last 4m.

emma: good. next: 1) keep canary paused for 20m of observation, 2) open PR to change migration to be additive (add column + backfill + swap) instead of rename, 3) add pre-deploy check to verify dependent objects (views/triggers) referencing old column names

rachel_db: creating emergency PR #2401 updating migration to ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS + backfill pattern and to check for dependent views/triggers. Tagging migration author @jonathan.

tony_release: customer comms: @product_cust2 — we detected transient errors for a small set of users on canary. We routed you to stable and deployed a DB compatibility patch; no action needed on your side.

product_cust2: thanks for the heads up. We noticed a couple of failed profile updates; resolved after ~10 minutes. Please advise if any data consistency checks are needed.

emma: we'll run a verification query to compare counts and sample rows between user_id and owner_id and share results. If anything inconsistent we'll run compensating updates.

rachel_db: verification: `SELECT count(*) FROM profiles WHERE owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM user_id;` -> 0 rows. Good. Backfill is sound.

nina: monitoring: replication lag normal (0-1s), no 5xx spike, latency stable.

emma: documenting timeline and mitigation; assigning postmortem owner @rachel_db. Also adding a runbook item: for schema changes that rename columns, prefer backward-compatible pattern (add+backfill+flip) and detect dependent DB objects in preflight.

ops-bot: Incident PD-67900 status -> mitigated (time to mitigation: 9m).

emma: handing off to @rachel_db to write postmortem and track followups. I'll update PagerDuty notes and mark on-call handoff to next shift @tony_release.

rachel_db: starting postmortem draft: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/PD-67900-draft. Followups: merge PR #2401, update deploy pipeline with dependency checks, add test in staging that runs migration twice to catch non-idempotent DDL.

ton y_release: resuming scheduled canary after 20m observation window at 10:15Z if metrics stay green.

emma: closing incident thread when postmortem link posted. Nice work team. :clap:

product_cust2: thanks everyone for the quick fix and clear comms.

ops-bot: PD-67900 closed at 10:34:49Z (status: resolved).
